title: dodag.py: Race condition in authenticated DIO - prepare_candidate reads state without lock
description:
Location: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py lines 480-545

In _process_authenticated_dio_evidence_unlocked, the prepare_candidate closure reads DODAG state without holding self._lock:
- Lines 502-507 read self.rpl_instance_id and self.dodag_id
- Line 529 calls _would_accept_dio_unlocked which reads: role, node_address, rpl_instance_id, dodag_id, version, rank, _lowest_rank, min_hop_rank_increase, max_rank_increase

The transaction protocol calls prepare without the lock (for I/O validation) then commit with consumer_lock=self._lock. However, between these phases:
- Another thread could call process_dio and change version/rank/_lowest_rank via _adopt_version
- The state read in prepare becomes stale by commit time
- TOCTOU: decision made on old state, committed to new state

Impact:
- Incorrect accept: prepare sees old version, accepts; commit runs on new version with incompatible state
- Incorrect reject: prepare sees transient state that would fail checks, but final state would pass
- Inconsistent state: prepare reads torn data if another thread is mid-_adopt_version

Fix: Either acquire lock around the state reads in prepare_candidate, or snapshot all needed fields atomically before calling transact_authenticated_schc_dio.
close_reason: Fixed by adding _DodagSnapshot frozen dataclass to capture DODAG state atomically under the lock before the prepare/commit transaction. Added _would_accept_dio_with_snapshot helper function that uses the snapshot instead of self. Updated _process_authenticated_dio_evidence_unlocked to snapshot state under lock before calling transact_authenticated_schc_dio, and modified prepare_candidate closure to use the snapshot.
